label: About
title: About Cutaway Pulse Under Concrete
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 282 recent saved-signal files and 247 captured links, then narrowed the page to 7 source windows around The Future Sound Of London - Environments 3 and Can - Halleluhwah (1971), plus 5 more. A source image from img.youtube.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Cutaway Pulse Under Concrete: Brutalist audio cutaway, architectural section as camera plate grammar: a black cover-field header with illegible white bar-traces above a compressed concrete world. One heavy diagonal ribbed slab drives across the upper frame, vertical pillars carve pale cyan sky pockets below, and a lower bass-ridge procession car... After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 7 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against dominant diagonal underside slab edge, lower ribbed pressure band, and left pillar cyan aperture.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
